tabs.title: Description
tabs.html:
The D CORE 4U 19-inch X439RM Rack Mount Case is a durable and spacious server chassis designed for enterprise IT, data center, and industrial applications. Built to fit standard 19-inch server racks, this 4U rack mount case provides excellent compatibility, airflow, and reliability for servers, storage systems, NVRs, NAS, and firewall appliances.


Constructed with heavy-duty steel, the X439RM ensures long-term durability and stable operation in continuous-run environments. Its optimized internal layout supports full-height expansion cards, multiple storage drives, and efficient cooling, making it ideal for high-performance systems. The front panel includes power and reset buttons with LED indicators for easy system monitoring.

The D CORE X439RM 4U server case is suitable for professional installations where clean cable management, strong chassis structure, and reliable airflow are essential. Whether you are building a data center server, surveillance NVR, or industrial control system, this rack mount chassis delivers dependable performance.
